name: mostlygeek/llama-swap
title: mostlygeek/llama-swap
headline: llama-swap swaps local models behind one compatible endpoint
lede: One OpenAI or Anthropic compatible endpoint can switch between local servers like llama.cpp and vllm on demand.

effects.effect: Gives a simple routing layer for mixed inference servers.
Makes multi-model local stacks easier to run on one machine.

possibilities.title: Firms barred from code APIs could run large MoE models on owned workstations

with.title: Colibri keeps trending on tiered MoE inference claim
Unsloth MiniMax-M3.1-Flash GGUFs run in about 150 GB RAM

possibilities.connection: Colibri tiers MoE experts across GPU, RAM and NVMe, Unsloth's 2-bit MiniMax GGUFs shrink the model by 45%, and llama-swap puts the result behind one compatible endpoint.

possibilities.title: Compliance teams must now inventory which model actually sits behind local endpoints

with.title: LiteLLM unifies cost accounting for budgets and reports

possibilities.connection: An obliterated DeepSeek variant spreading fast, llama-swap putting any local server behind one compatible endpoint, and LiteLLM's per-model spend slicing together make silent model swaps both likely and detectable.

possibilities.connection: AA-Omniscience now has a 300-question public set calibrated to its private set with the same Net Score scoring, and llama-swap puts Clover 35B A3B and an autoregressive Qwen model behind one endpoint so both can be scored in one run.
